name: 33639-hicachechurn-qwen3next80b-tp4
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Thinking -- bf16, unquantized, hybrid full-attention/Gated-DeltaNet. Not substitutable.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 of one node (--gres=gpu:8, four used).
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism. One node.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 1280 requests with a 5400 s safety cap. Seed 33639.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn: one of 128 distinct 6400-token system prompts followed by a unique 3600-token question, generating 500 tokens; all lengths fixed. `ignore_eos` and temperature 0.0 go in `backend.extras.body`.
purpose: A reasoning assistant answering 10,000-token policy questions from 128 shared briefings, 32 concurrent users, four GPUs.
launch:
# `sglang serve` CLI form: one `key: value` per line. A nested block is DROPPED silently,
# which would start the engine without something this file claims to declare.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Thinking
tp-size: 4

enable-hierarchical-cache: true
hicache-ratio: 12
hicache-write-policy: write_through
hicache-io-backend: direct
hicache-mem-layout: page_first_direct
mamba-radix-cache-strategy: extra_buffer

max-total-tokens: 131072
# 160 is the FLOOR that still admits 32 running requests: the engine reserves five recurrent slots
# per running request under `extra_buffer`, so a lower value silently caps --max-running-requests
# below 32. This value, --max-total-tokens and the 32 streams are one pinned operating point, not
# headroom to tune.
max-mamba-cache-size: 160
max-running-requests: 32
chunked-prefill-size: 16384
max-prefill-tokens: 32768
page-size: 64
mem-fraction-static: 0.85

# The full-attention layers only. Leave --linear-attn-backend at its `triton` default: the cache
# strategy above is offered to this architecture on that backend only.
attention-backend: triton

random-seed: 33639
